title: Support for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander business owners
summary: This page provides resources and support for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander business owners in NSW.

external_links.text: Online resources Access free videos and articles on a range of topics.
Grants and funding finder Find a NSW Government initiative, grant or funding program.
Aboriginal Economic Development NSW Government team supporting regional Aboriginal business, employment and training.
NSW Indigenous Chamber of Commerce Peak body for Indigenous business in NSW.
Yarpa Services, resources and networks for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander businesses.
Supply Nation Leading database of verified Indigenous businesses.
Many Rivers Support to develop your business, including microfinance loans.
Indigenous Business Australia Business finance and partnerships for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander entrepreneurs.

internal_links.text: Starting a business Learn how to set up your business, choose the right structure and apply for key registrations.
Manage and grow Solve business challenges, build your skills or explore new opportunities.

faqs.q: Where can I find support for my Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander business?
faqs.a: You can find support through various resources, including the NSW Indigenous Chamber of Commerce, Yarpa Services, and Supply Nation.

faqs.q: What resources are available for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander businesses?
faqs.a: Resources include information on starting and growing a business, accessing funding, and connecting with networks.

faqs.q: How can I find funding or grants for my business?
faqs.a: You can use the Grants and funding finder to locate NSW Government initiatives, grants, or funding programs.
